entries.zh: 衷情；内心的情意、由衷的情感
entries.en: affection of the heart; innermost feelings

entries.zh: 志向；心志所向、抱负（西释义兼指倾心过甚、随其情欲而行）
entries.en: inclination/aspiration of the will; inordinate affection, going after one's passion
entries.notes: 西语 'afecto demasiado / ir se tras su pasion' 与汉义'志向'对应较松，释义取两栏折中。
闽音栏 'thì cor.' 含无法确解的 'cor.' 残片，但汉形'剃'＋官话 tŷ＋西语'afeitar con nabaja'互证剃除义。

entries.zh: 剃毛须；用剃刀剃去毛发（须）
entries.en: to shave off hair (and beard) with a razor
entries.notes: 第三字录作'檨'，与音写 côu/cǔ 不合，疑为'鬚'之形误或借字；据西语'afeitar con nabaja'与'剃毛'定剃除毛发义。

entries.en: to smear/anoint (apply with oil); to spread on
to powder the face; a woman's use of makeup, to adorn oneself
to cut one's hair; to trim the hair with scissors

entries.zh: 作妆（作状）；修饰面容眉睫，打扮入时
entries.en: to dress/fix up the face and eyebrows; to make oneself up, adorn
a woman's pretty (coquettish) adornment; to dress oneself up
a woman's toilette: to comb the hair and adorn oneself

entries.zh: 红颜；红润姣好之容颜（精心妆饰之貌）
entries.en: a rosy, carefully adorned countenance; beauty of complexion (fine adornment)

entries.zh: 纸人；纸扎之人，喻男子柔弱无丈夫气（如纸般软）
entries.en: a paper man; an effeminate, weak man

entries.zh: 系（繫）；系心、倾心于某事物
entries.en: to attach oneself to something; to become fond of

entries.zh: 系恋；恋慕不舍、沉溺流连（于不正当之事）
entries.en: to be attached to / long for; to cling to improprieties (vices)

entries.zh: 引动；打动、撩动（人心），使人倾心
entries.en: to stir/move (someone's heart); to incite, to make (someone) fond

entries.zh: 姻亲；因婚姻结成的亲眷
entries.notes: 汉形'忝'本义（辱、愧）不合，当系闽南语借音字（音 tiàm）；M 栏另附 'sachchàm' 无从确解，释义据西语定义与 M/R 对音。

entries.zh: 姻亲；因婚姻相附而结成的亲眷（忝附是亲）
entries.notes: R 栏第三音节 zū 与汉字'是'（M 栏 sȳ）不吻合，或系转写之误；'忝'疑为'添附'之借音。
